resolved_activation_debt.resolution: Removed parallel canonical launcher diagnostic store. Standard Delivery captures through diagnostic_capsule.py and exposes CEREBRO_PATCH_FAIL.json as a derived bounded transport view.
Split lightweight patch-close Source integrity from full system/release closure and wired the lightweight closure before Contract Activation Closure and canonical sync.

STANDARD profile selection is pre-artifact only; sealed package identity governs runtime. Canonical launcher/kernel owns new STANDARD execution, legacy cpatch is compatibility-only, and one launcher invocation authorizes the declared RunToPass chain.

All required standards now have explicit traced activation dispositions; semantic-review placeholders are removed without falsely promoting policy or partially operational contracts.

Promoted the exact AA-003 shadow-validated resolver through one canonical MCP-owned live control-resolution wrapper, preserved material preflight precedence and direct-resolver non-live semantics, and bound the normal control path to fresh runtime activation evidence.

Generalized changed-path dependency closure now enumerates every RUNTIME_EVIDENCE binding across the activation registry, binds every invalidated proof to a producer, executes the producers on the exact disposable candidate, and requires actual Contract Activation Closure before human handoff.
STANDARD delivery consumes CAC v2 blocking_findings directly and reports their count and content; nonexistent legacy activation_gap_count can no longer mask the primary Contract Activation failure.

The 2-5 word human continuation rule is now an OPERATIONAL constitutional binding with an Interaction consumer, Presentation pre-handoff block-and-rerender gate, deterministic response validator, sealed-candidate selftest and runtime activation evidence. Full continuation state remains machine-owned and the visible phrase is only a trigger.

The Standard Delivery launcher now validates the canonical PASS receipt and recovery proof, verifies a byte-identical stable CEREBRO_PATCH_SUCCESS.json transport copy, records its path in attempt history and prints one UPLOAD_FILE value.
